ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the diagram is a material cycle of the lithosphere, including boxes such as “magma”, “magmatic rock”, “sedimentary rock”, and “metamorphic rock”. The number 4 in the figure is marked beside the upward arrow from the bottom “magma” to the upper “magmatic rock”. Then reason: in the material cycle of the lithosphere, after magma rises, it forms magmatic rock through cooling and solidification, so number 4 represents the condensation process by which magma forms magmatic rock.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像结构：图中有“岩浆”“岩浆岩”“沉积岩”“变质岩”等框，编号4位于从底部“岩浆”到上部“岩浆岩”的向上箭头旁。再结合岩石圈物质循环知识，岩浆上升后冷却凝固形成岩浆岩，所以图中4代表冷凝作用。
